children: TSLA: September Shanghai deliveries 95,366 (up 5% YoY, ~11% MoM). Exports rose ~58%, China sales fell ~9.4%. Q3 global deliveries 486,532; production 464,391; Model 3/Y = 478,237.
Elon Musk says Tesla will own and operate the Terafab chip fab, running it even if TSMC joins as a subprocessor; Tesla retains primary ownership and operational control.
Traders watch Tesla (TSLA) as rising international deliveries could affect margins. Focus: regional registration data, upcoming financials, pricing pressure and incentives' impact on revenue mix.
Tesla (TSLA) cut prices on select China Model Y variants by up to ¥7,000, noting potential profit impact as volume grows. Shares rose about 3.2% to $386.93 on Oct 9.
TSLA saw tougher competition in China as August EV sales showed BYD leading and domestic brands gaining, pressuring Tesla’s local market share and sales momentum.
Tesla (TSLA) renamed its European driver-assist from “Full Self-Driving” to “Tesla Assisted Driving.” EU sites show the change; U.S. site still uses “Full Self-Driving (Supervised).”
Yorkville Ives started coverage of Tesla (TSLA) with an Outperform, citing Tesla’s exposure to AI-related hardware and systems as key for public-market investors.
Goldman Sachs says Tesla's near-term stock moves will hinge more on AI and robotics updates than quarterly earnings ahead of TSLA’s Oct. 21 Q3 report.
Tesla (TSLA) reports ~2.5M cumulative paid Robotaxi miles and advancing a Cybercab; traders watch fleet utilization, revenue per vehicle, operating costs, and regulatory/safety updates.
European regulators in Sweden, Italy and other countries are probing Tesla (TSLA) over its 'Full Self-Driving' name, saying it may mislead buyers into thinking no driver supervision is needed.
